ProfileMeResponse.description:
Full computed profile for the current user. Embedding vector is
intentionally omitted — clients never need the raw 1024-dim array.
ProfileMeResponse.title: ProfileMeResponse

QuestionnaireAnswers.description:
v2 questionnaire shape. Maps 1:1 onto question IDs in
`Frinq Design System/dist/questions.jsx`. All fields are optional at the
schema layer because the frontend may save partial drafts — the builder
enforces what's structurally required.
QuestionnaireAnswers.title: QuestionnaireAnswers

job_id.description: ARQ job id for the queued build_profile task; null if the queue is unreachable
job_id.title: Job Id

RegisterRequest.description:
Called once on first login after Supabase Auth issues a JWT.

The Supabase UID and phone come from the JWT itself — only the user-supplied
fields appear in the body.
RegisterRequest.title: RegisterRequest

VoiceAnswer.description:
Q40 storytime — voice transcription result (frontend uploads audio,
backend transcribes via Groq and stores the transcript in this shape).
VoiceAnswer.title: VoiceAnswer

get.description:
Who tapped which invite button — the source for follow-up sends.
rsvp_status is rsvp_yes / rsvp_no / rsvp_info; rsvp_at is the tap time.

schema.title: Response List Rsvps Api V1 Admin Rsvps Get

post.description:
Manually re-run startup migrations + return per-statement results.

The old version swallowed exceptions and returned a bare 'ok'. This
version reports each statement's outcome so we can see exactly which
DDL was rejected (suspected: API user lacks ALTER TABLE permission
on Supabase, which is why migrations silent-fail at startup).

schema.title: Response Run Migrations Now Api V1 Admin Run Migrations Post

get.description:
Return all columns on quiz_submissions so we can see exactly what's
actually present in the live DB. Also runs the new SELECT once and
reports any error — lets us debug 'admin 500s' without DO log access.

schema.title: Response Schema Check Api V1 Admin Schema Get

post.description:
Send first_follow_up to all drop-offs that haven't been messaged yet.

Body: { ids?: [uuid, ...] } — optional list of specific submission ids
to target. Omit to send to ALL incomplete submissions with phone +
no prior followup. Returns per-user results.

Skips: complete submissions, no-phone rows, already-sent rows,
test rows (is_test = true).

schema.title: Response Send Followups Bulk Api V1 Admin Send Followups Bulk Post
Response List Submissions Api V1 Admin Submissions Get

post.description:
Delete multiple submissions in one call. Body: { ids: [uuid, ...] }.
Used when admin wants to clean up all the test/dev rows in one go.

schema.title: Response Bulk Delete Submissions Api V1 Admin Submissions Bulk Delete Post

delete.description:
Delete a submission and all related rows.

voice_clips has ON DELETE CASCADE on submission_id so audio rows
auto-vanish. tracking_events uses session_id (not FK to submissions)
so those stay — they're analytics-only.

No soft-delete: when admin clicks delete, the row is gone. Confirm
on the client side before calling.

schema.title: Response Delete Submission Api V1 Admin Submissions  Submission Id  Delete
Response Get Submission Api V1 Admin Submissions  Submission Id  Get

get.description: Same faithful raw transcript as a CSV (no spreadsheet app needed).

Download ONE user's raw responses as Excel — exact question wording, exact
answers, every sub-question (opinions / whys / sliders / rapid-fire) expanded.
No AI: a faithful transcript of how they actually filled the quiz.

patch.description:
Update admin-only flags + notes on a submission.

Body keys (all optional, only sent fields are updated):
  - admin_notes:  text annotation for analysis
  - is_test:      manual flag to mark/unmark as test row
  - is_approved:  flag for 'inside the 100' gatekeeping

No password gate — these are reversible and low-risk. Useful for
daily admin work without paying the password prompt.

schema.title: Response Update Flags Api V1 Admin Submissions  Submission Id  Flags Patch

post.description:
Reset whatsapp_sent_at so the next /whatsapp/notify call goes
through again. Useful if the first send failed for any reason
(Twilio outage, template not yet approved at send time, etc).

Password-gated because re-sending costs money + can annoy users
if mis-fired.

schema.title: Response Resend Whatsapp Api V1 Admin Submissions  Submission Id  Resend Whatsapp Post

post.description:
Re-trigger AI insights generation for a failed or errored submission —
routed through the same durable worker + community-assignment pipeline
every other completion path uses (generate_quiz_insights), not a
separate ad-hoc regeneration. No FastAPI BackgroundTask: a crash between
the admin click and the AI call finishing must not silently lose the job.

schema.title: Response Retry Ai Api V1 Admin Submissions  Submission Id  Retry Ai Post

post.description:
Send the 'first_follow_up' template to one drop-off user.

Idempotent: tracked via followup_sent_at column. If already sent,
returns ok + already_sent so admin can safely click without spamming.

schema.title: Response Send Followup One Api V1 Admin Submissions  Submission Id  Send Followup Post

post.description:
Programmatically create a Twilio Content Template + submit for
WhatsApp approval. Used to recreate a template that's already
approved on Meta WABA side so we get the HX SID we need for sending.

Body (all optional, sensible defaults for first_followup):
    friendly_name: str   - twilio template name
    language:      str   - "en"
    body:          str   - the message body
    image_url:     str   - header image URL
    button_title:  str   - CTA button text
    button_url:    str   - URL the button opens
    category:      str   - "MARKETING" | "UTILITY"

Returns: sid (HX...), approval_status, full response from Twilio.

schema.title: Response Twilio Create Template Api V1 Admin Twilio Create Template Post

get.description:
List all Twilio Content Templates on this account.

Helper for finding the HX… SID of an approved template by name when
the Twilio Console is hard to navigate. Returns sid + friendly_name +
language + variables for each template.

schema.title: Response List Twilio Templates Api V1 Admin Twilio Templates Get

Response Suspend User Api V1 Admin Users  User Id  Suspend Post

get.description:
Diagnose 'voice uploads aren't saving' reports — checks if the
table exists, total row count, and the 10 most recent uploads.

schema.title: Response Voice Stats Api V1 Admin Voice Stats Get

get.description:
List voice clips uploaded for a submission. Returns metadata + a
streaming URL the admin UI can use as the <audio> src.

Returns empty `clips` + `table_missing: true` if the voice_clips
table doesn't exist (instead of HTTP 500), so the admin UI doesn't
break the whole user detail panel when the migration hasn't run yet.

schema.title: Response List Voice Clips Api V1 Admin Voice  Submission Id  Get

get.description:
Stream the audio bytes for one clip. The admin app fetches this as a
blob (Authorization: Bearer header) and assigns it via
URL.createObjectURL — no query-param key needed.

Marketing funnel for the invite campaign, computed from Twilio message
statuses (per recipient: best delivery state + error codes) joined with our
RSVP/inbound data. Cached for 90s to avoid hammering Twilio.

schema.title: Response Whatsapp Campaign Api V1 Admin Whatsapp Campaign Get

get.description:
Everything the admin RSVP/inbox UI needs:
- counts:     how many tapped each button (rsvp_yes/no/info)
- responders: who tapped what (current), with name
- messages:   every inbound message (button + free-form), newest first

schema.title: Response Whatsapp Inbox Api V1 Admin Whatsapp Inbox Get

post.description:
Send a free-form WhatsApp reply to one person. Works only inside the 24h
window opened by their last inbound message (else Twilio 63016).

schema.title: Response Whatsapp Reply Api V1 Admin Whatsapp Reply Post

get.description:
Full WhatsApp conversation with one person (both directions), from
Twilio — so it includes our template sends, auto-replies and their messages.

schema.title: Response Whatsapp Thread Api V1 Admin Whatsapp Thread Get

post.description:
Refresh tokens are accepted only in the JSON body — never as a query
param or header, both of which risk ending up in access logs.

Sends an OTP to the account's own stored phone only — never accepts
a phone field, so this can't be used to send an OTP to someone else's
number under an authenticated session.

schema.title: Response Reverify Request Api V1 Auth Reverify Request Post

post.description:
On success, returns a single-purpose reauth token bound to this user
ID, session ID, and the account_delete action — 5-minute expiry,
single-use (app/core/reverify.py). Never a general-purpose login token.

schema.title: Response Update Preferences Api V1 Community Preferences Patch
Response Accept Legal Api V1 Legal Accept Post
Response Report Message Api V1 Messages  Message Id  Report Post

post.description:
Verify the OTP code with Twilio. Then (only on success) look up
prior session. Sequential — was previously parallel via create_task but
the concurrency was making failure modes unpredictable.

patch.description:
Mark an existing partial submission as complete and enqueue the
durable insights job — no FastAPI BackgroundTask, no in-process work
that a restart could silently drop.

schema.title: Response Complete Quiz Api V1 Quiz Complete  Submission Id  Patch

patch.description: Save partial answers mid-quiz so nothing is lost if user drops off.

schema.title: Response Save Partial Api V1 Quiz Partial  Submission Id  Patch

post.description:
Create an initial tracking record as soon as user enters their phone
so drop-offs between phone-entry and OTP-verify still appear in admin.

If the same phone already has a recent incomplete submission (last 24h),
return that id instead of creating a duplicate.

schema.title: Response Start Quiz Api V1 Quiz Start Post

post.description:
Owner-only, same as complete_quiz — this is the vibe-box fallback path
when a PATCH /quiz/complete/{id} attempt fails, so it needs the identical
auth/age-gate/durability treatment or it becomes a bypass for all three.

Requeue a submission that failed durable processing. Only the owner
may retry, only while status='error' (an active/processing submission
can't be duplicated this way), and only up to 3 total attempts.

schema.title: Response Retry Quiz Api V1 Quiz  Submission Id  Retry Post

post.description:
Insert into tracking_events. Never raises — tracking failures must not
break the client. Logs server-side and returns ok=False if DB write fails
or the event isn't on the allowlist. Never accepts phone/name from the
client — those columns are legacy and stay unpopulated from this path.

schema.title: Response Track Event Api V1 Track Post

delete.description:
Requires a fresh reauth token (POST /auth/reverify/request + /verify)
bound to this exact user+session — a login access token or a token for
a different action is rejected by consume_reauth_token itself.

A real hard delete, not a soft-delete flag: quiz_submissions/
user_sessions/community_members/user_blocks/push_tokens/
legal_acceptances all CASCADE; messages.user_id/
message_reports.reporter_user_id/moderation_actions.target_user_id all
SET NULL, preserving chat/audit history while permanently disconnecting
it from this account (voice_clips cascades transitively via
quiz_submissions). tracking_events has no FK to users at all (bare
phone column) and is cleaned explicitly below.

schema.title: Response Unblock User Api V1 Users  User Id  Block Delete
Response Block User Api V1 Users  User Id  Block Post

post.description:
Accept an audio blob from the voice recorder, upsert into voice_clips.

Re-recording the same question for the same submission overwrites the
previous take (ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE). Returns size + ok so the client
can confirm the upload succeeded.

schema.title: Response Upload Voice Api V1 Voice Post

post.description:
Twilio inbound webhook for the FRINQ-Whatsapp messaging service.
Auto-replies to RSVP button taps and records the choice. Returns TwiML.

Parses the raw urlencoded body (Twilio always posts
application/x-www-form-urlencoded) so we don't depend on python-multipart.
